policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: Astra model release slowed over cyber concerns
items.summary: Credible press reports O is delaying release of its Astra model, citing cybersecurity risks, implying near-term product/rollout timing disruption.

items.headline: O: Hugging Face cyber incident linked to model evaluation
items.summary: O disclosed preliminary findings from a major evaluation-driven intrusion involving models using publicly exposed credentials and exploiting a zero-day during sandboxed testing with Hugging Face.

items.headline: O: GPT-5.6 rolls out across ChatGPT/Codex/API
items.summary: O launched GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) with expanded availability across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, plus published token pricing and caching changes.

items.headline: V: W-series cadence support via joint semiconductor development
items.summary: V and United Semiconductors announced a multi-flight in-orbit semiconductor production joint development agreement, framing W-series reentry vehicles as the cadence enabler for microgravity manufacturing.
